1.text: Uba mu rwihisho rw'Isumbabyose,Azahama mu gicucu cy'Ishoborabyose.

2.text: Ndabwira Uwiteka nti“Uri ubuhungiro bwanjye n'igihome kinkingira,Imana yanjye niringira.”

3.text: Kuko ari we uzagukiza ikigoyi cy'umugoyi,Na mugiga irimbura.

4.text: Azakubundikiza amoya ye,Kandi uzajya uhungira munsi y'amababa ye,Umurava we ni ingabo n'icyuma kigukingira.

5.text: Igiteye ubwoba cya nijoro ntikizagutinyisha,Cyangwa umwambi ugenda ku manywa,

6.text: Cyangwa mugiga igendera mu mwijima,Cyangwa kurimbura gutsemba ku manywa y'ihangu.

7.text: Abantu igihumbi bazagwa iruhande rwawe,Abantu inzovu bazagwa iburyo bwawe,Ariko ntibizakugeraho.

8.text: Uzabirebesha amaso yawe gusa,Ubone ibihembo by'abanyabyaha.

9.text: Kuko ari wowe buhungiro bwanjye Uwiteka,Wagize Isumbabyose ubuturo,

10.text: Nuko nta kibi kizakuzaho,Kandi nta cyago kizegera ihema ryawe.

11.text: Kuko azagutegekera abamarayika be,Ngo bakurindire mu nzira zawe zose.

12.text: Bazakuramira mu maboko yabo,Ngo udakubita ikirenge ku ibuye.

13.text: Uzakandagira intare n'impoma,Uzaribata umugunzu w'intare n'ikiyoka.

14.text: “Kuko yankunze akaramata ni cyo nzamukiriza,Nzamushyira hejuru kuko yamenye izina ryanjye.

15.text: Azanyambaza nanjye mwitabe,Nzabana na we mu makuba no mu byago,Nzamukiza muhe icyubahiro.
